posts.text: Ladies and gentlemen, the President of the United States

Pete Hegseth said "it takes money to kill bad guys" while asking for $200 BILLION for a war that didn't exist 3 weeks ago as DHS is closed and Americans pay record gas prices. These are the people who screamed about the debt every single day
Trump said he expected gas prices to be worse after starting a war. They’re up almost a dollar in a month. This is what “under control” looks like?
This is going full cult at this point.

Trump seems to realize that his presidency could effectively be over after November’s elections and he is going full scorched earth, ignoring all advice to back off of this belligerent Iran scheme. It’s the presidential version of pooping in the sandbox to ruin it for the other kids when mommy says it’s time to go home.
Gas is up 42% in the last 2 months under The Affordability President™

Americans concerned about affordability will certainly rejoice in Donald Trump starting an optional war with Iran with unclear goals and sending gas prices skyrocketing. This is exactly the sort of thing voters will reward in November when they go to vote. (Hopefully this is sarcasm)
It should be a global red alert that this week Trump said he might “free Cuba,” or “take Cuba” or “whatever he wants to do with it.” This is some of the darkest authoritarian rhetoric there is.

Guys…his hands look like they’re turning green now. WTF?

Video
Wouldn't this be the perfect job for Trump's prestigious “Board of Peace” to get this war ended? If it weren't a total phony scam, I mean.

Seriously, what is wrong with this guy?


David Pakman Show (@davidpakmanshow)

So the Trump administration controls Venezuela’s oil as a result of Trump’s kidnapping of Maduro, and that oil supply’s value has exploded thanks to Trump’s optional war with Iran. Got it.

Trump dances like a lunatic for a crowd clapping like trained seals as 8 American servicemembers have been killed and gas prices are up 30% since January thanks to his optional war.
